# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

### bilateral_trade
Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

### bilateral_trade
Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# ---------- DATA ----------
# Tariff rates (half-year)
tariff_periods = [
    '2017\nH1','2017\nH2','2018\nH1','2018\nH2','2019\nH1','2019\nH2',
    '2020\nH1','2020\nH2','2021\nH1','2021\nH2','2022\nH1','2022\nH2',
    '2023\nH1','2023\nH2','2024\nH1'
]
tariff_x = np.arange(len(tariff_periods))
us_tariff = [3.1,3.1,3.8,12.0,18.3,21.0,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,25.4]
cn_tariff = [8.0,8.0,8.0,16.5,20.7,21.8,20.9,20.9,20.9,20.9,21.1,21.1,21.2,21.2,23.1]

# Bilateral trade (annual)
trade_years = [2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024]
us_exports = [115.6,129.9,120.3,106.4,124.5,151.1,153.8,147.8,138.2]
us_imports = [462.6,505.5,539.5,452.2,435.4,506.4,536.8,427.2,401.5]
total_trade = [578.2,635.4,659.8,558.6,559.9,657.5,690.6,575.0,539.7]

# Supply chain share (annual)
sc_years = trade_years
china_share = [21.4,21.6,21.2,18.1,18.6,17.9,16.5,13.9,12.8]
vietnam_share = [2.1,2.2,2.6,2.9,3.4,3.7,3.9,4.5,4.9]
india_share = [2.1,2.2,2.3,2.4,2.3,2.7,2.8,3.1,3.4]

# Policy events for annotation (date_approx_index on tariff x-axis, short label)
events = [
    (1, 'Section 301\nInvestigation', 'investigation'),
    (2, 'Section 301\nMemo', 'tariff'),
    (3, 'Lists 1-3\nTariffs', 'tariff'),
    (4, 'List 3\nRaised to 25%', 'tariff'),
    (5, 'List 4A\nTariffs', 'tariff'),
    (6, 'Phase One\nDeal', 'deal'),
    (9, 'USTR Tariff\nReview', 'review'),
    (14, 'Biden Tariff\nEscalation', 'tariff'),
]

# ---------- STYLE ----------
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'figure.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.alpha': 0.3,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.5,
})

# Colors - editorial palette
C_US = '#1B4F72'      # dark blue
C_CN = '#C0392B'      # red
C_VIETNAM = '#27AE60' # green
C_INDIA = '#E67E22'   # orange
C_TRADE = '#2C3E50'   # dark
C_EXP = '#5DADE2'     # light blue
C_IMP = '#1B4F72'     # dark blue
CAT_COLORS = {'tariff': '#E74C3C', 'investigation': '#F39C12', 'deal': '#27AE60', 'review': '#3498DB'}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14), dpi=180)
fig.suptitle('US–China Trade War Dynamics: Tariffs, Trade, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.975, color='#1a1a1a')
fig.text(0.5, 0.955, 'Tariff escalation, bilateral trade volume trajectories, and the diversification of US import sources',
         ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#555', style='italic')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 2, height_ratios=[1.2, 1, 1], hspace=0.38, wspace=0.28,
                       left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.93, bottom=0.05)

# ===== PANEL A: Tariff Escalation (full width) =====
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax1.step(tariff_x, us_tariff, where='mid', color=C_US, linewidth=2.5, label='US Tariff on China')
ax1.step(tariff_x, cn_tariff, where='mid', color=C_CN, linewidth=2.5, label='China Tariff on US', linestyle='--')
ax1.fill_between(tariff_x, us_tariff, alpha=0.10, step='mid', color=C_US)
ax1.fill_between(tariff_x, cn_tariff, alpha=0.08, step='mid', color=C_CN)

# Annotations
y_offsets = iter([2.5, -3.5, 2.5, -3.5, 2.5, -3.5, 2.5, -3.0])
for xi, label, cat in events:
    yval = max(us_tariff[xi], cn_tariff[xi])
    yo = next(y_offsets)
    ax1.annotate(label, xy=(xi, yval), xytext=(xi, yval + yo + 4),
                 fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='bottom', color=CAT_COLORS[cat], fontweight='bold',
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=CAT_COLORS[cat], lw=0.8))

ax1.set_xticks(tariff_x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(tariff_periods, fontsize=7)
ax1.set_ylabel('Average Effective Tariff Rate (%)')
ax1.set_title('A. Tariff Escalation Timeline with Policy Milestones', loc='left')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 38)
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, fontsize=9)

# Category legend
cat_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=v, label=k.capitalize()) for k, v in CAT_COLORS.items()]
leg2 = ax1.legend(handles=cat_patches, loc='center left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 0.45),
                  title='Event Type', fontsize=7, title_fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9)
ax1.add_artist(ax1.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, fontsize=9))

# ===== PANEL B: Bilateral Trade Volume =====
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
width = 0.35
x_trade = np.arange(len(trade_years))
ax2.bar(x_trade - width/2, us_imports, width, color=C_IMP, alpha=0.85, label='US Imports from China')
ax2.bar(x_trade + width/2, us_exports, width, color=C_EXP, alpha=0.85, label='US Exports to China')
ax2.plot(x_trade, total_trade, 'o-', color=C_TRADE, linewidth=2, markersize=5, label='Total Bilateral', zorder=5)

# Highlight dip
for i in [3, 4]:  # 2019, 2020
    ax2.axvspan(i - 0.45, i + 0.45, alpha=0.07, color='red')
ax2.text(3.5, 690, 'Peak tariff\nperiod', ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#C0392B', fontstyle='italic')

ax2.set_xticks(x_trade)
ax2.set_xticklabels(trade_years)
ax2.set_ylabel('Billion USD')
ax2.set_title('B. US–China Bilateral Trade Volume', loc='left')
ax2.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)

# ===== PANEL C: Bilateral trade line detail =====
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax3.plot(trade_years, total_trade, 's-', color=C_TRADE, linewidth=2.5, markersize=7, label='Total Bilateral Trade')
for i, (y, v) in enumerate(zip(trade_years, total_trade)):
    ax3.annotate(f'${v:.0f}B', (y, v), textcoords='offset points', xytext=(0, 10),
                 fontsize=7, ha='center', color=C_TRADE, fontweight='bold')

# Shade phases
ax3.axvspan(2018, 2020, alpha=0.08, color='red', label='Tariff Escalation')
ax3.axvspan(2020, 2022, alpha=0.08, color='green', label='Partial Recovery')
ax3.axvspan(2022, 2024, alpha=0.08, color='orange', label='Renewed Decline')

ax3.set_ylabel('Billion USD')
ax3.set_title('C. Trade Volume Trajectory & Phases', loc='left')
ax3.legend(fontsize=7, loc='lower left', framealpha=0.9)
ax3.set_xlim(2015.5, 2024.5)

# ===== PANEL D: Supply Chain Shares =====
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax4.plot(sc_years, china_share, 'o-', color=C_CN, linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='China')
ax4.plot(sc_years, vietnam_share, 's-', color=C_VIETNAM, linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='Vietnam')
ax4.plot(sc_years, india_share, '^-', color=C_INDIA, linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='India')
ax4.fill_between(sc_years, china_share, alpha=0.1, color=C_CN)

# Vertical line at 2018
ax4.axvline(2018, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)
ax4.text(2018.1, 20.5, 'Trade war\nbegins', fontsize=7, color='gray', fontstyle='italic')

# Arrows showing direction
ax4.annotate('', xy=(2024, 12.8), xytext=(2024, 16),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_CN, lw=2))
ax4.annotate('', xy=(2024, 4.9), xytext=(2024, 3.2),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_VIETNAM, lw=2))

ax4.set_ylabel('Share of Total US Imports (%)')
ax4.set_title('D. US Import Source Diversification', loc='left')
ax4.legend(fontsize=8, loc='center right', framealpha=0.9)
ax4.set_xlim(2015.5, 2024.5)

# ===== PANEL E: Indexed change since 2016 =====
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
china_idx = [c / china_share[0] * 100 for c in china_share]
viet_idx = [v / vietnam_share[0] * 100 for v in vietnam_share]
india_idx = [i / india_share[0] * 100 for i in india_share]

ax5.plot(sc_years, china_idx, 'o-', color=C_CN, linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='China')
ax5.plot(sc_years, viet_idx, 's-', color=C_VIETNAM, linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='Vietnam')
ax5.plot(sc_years, india_idx, '^-', color=C_INDIA, linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='India')
ax5.axhline(100, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)
ax5.axvline(2018, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)

ax5.text(2024.1, china_idx[-1], f'{china_idx[-1]:.0f}', fontsize=8, color=C_CN, fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax5.text(2024.1, viet_idx[-1], f'{viet_idx[-1]:.0f}', fontsize=8, color=C_VIETNAM, fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax5.text(2024.1, india_idx[-1], f'{india_idx[-1]:.0f}', fontsize=8, color=C_INDIA, fontweight='bold', va='center')

ax5.set_ylabel('Index (2016 = 100)')
ax5.set_title('E. Import Share Change (Indexed to 2016)', loc='left')
ax5.legend(fontsize=8, loc='center left', framealpha=0.9)
ax5.set_xlim(2015.5, 2025)

# Source note
fig.text(0.07, 0.008, 'Source: USTR, USITC, US Census Bureau trade statistics. Tariff rates are trade-weighted averages. 2024 data is partial/estimated.',
         fontsize=7, color='#888')
